title: Service Contracts: rate basis and freight-index figures by tier
content:
## Scope
This reference sets out, for each Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts tier, the rate bases the tier may be written on and the three figures that govern the quarterly re-indexing of an index-linked base rate: the index band, the pass-through share and the quarterly cap.

## Parameters by tier
| Tier | Rate bases allowed | Index band (% movement with no adjustment) | Pass-through (% of the index movement) | Cap on one quarter's adjustment (USD per FEU, up or down) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Starter Service Contract | fixed rate only | 5 | 100 | 400.00 |
| AHL Standard Service Contract | fixed rate only | 5 | 100 | 400.00 |
| AHL Regional Account Contract | fixed rate or index-linked | 5 | 100 | 350.00 |
| AHL Key Account Contract | fixed rate or index-linked | 4 | 90 | 300.00 |
| AHL Global Account Contract | fixed rate or index-linked | 3 | 85 | 250.00 |
| AHL Strategic Partner Contract | fixed rate or index-linked | 2 | 80 | 200.00 |

## What each figure means
- **Index band**: the movement of the line's published freight index, in whole percent, inside which no quarterly adjustment is made.
- **Pass-through**: the share of the index movement, in whole percent, that is passed through to the contract rate.
- **Cap**: the largest quarterly adjustment of the base rate, in USD per FEU, applying equally to a rise and to a fall.

## Tier notes
- An index-linked contract can be written only in the AHL Regional Account Contract, AHL Key Account Contract, AHL Global Account Contract and AHL Strategic Partner Contract tiers; the Starter and Standard tiers may be written on a fixed rate only.
- Up the ladder from Regional Account, the band narrows (5, 4, 3, 2 %), the pass-through share falls (100, 90, 85, 80 %) and the cap falls (350.00, 300.00, 250.00, 200.00 USD per FEU).

## Quick question
**A customer asks for an index-linked AHL Standard Service Contract. Is that rate basis open to the tier?** No. The AHL Standard Service Contract lists the fixed rate basis only.
